what_it_does: Creates a new toolkit called Calder to measure how accurately simplified test applications represent the behavior of larger real High-Performance Computing (HPC) applications. Scientists and engineers use these simplified 'proxy' applications to test and optimize systems, but nobody had a consistent way to verify that these proxies actually mimic the real application's performance characteristics. The toolkit uses similarity algorithms and statistical scoring methods to identify the most important features of HPC applications and quantify proxy fidelity.
